content.text:
This is expected behavior, not a bug.

**Why:** Tailwind scans source files as plain text and can't resolve `{{ Vite::image(...) }}` at build time — it needs the *complete* class string statically present in your source. `bg-[url('{{ ... }}')]` is dynamic interpolation, so Tailwind never generates the corresponding CSS rule, and the class does nothing at runtime.

**Source:** `src/docs/detecting-classes-in-source-files.mdx`, "Dynamic class names" section (lines 65–131) — "Since Tailwind scans your source files as plain text, it has no way of understanding string concatenation or interpolation... Always use complete class names."

Your fix (inline `style="background-image: url(...)"`) is the correct workaround — inline styles bypass the scanner entirely, so dynamic/computed values work fine there.
